text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
Ah-wa-wa~ I'm so sorry, forgive me! 
Yawning like that, I'm totally letting my 
guard down, aren't I!
choice_data_list: You look sleepy, did something happen?

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
Auuugh... Actually, last night... I 
started reflecting in my head and just 
couldn't stop.

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
Why do I always trip in the hallway, fall 
down the stairs, or slip on the slope and 
end up doing three backflips in a row...?

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
"Anyway, there were just so many things I 
had to reflect on that before I knew it, 
morning came... I'm so, so sorry~~!"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
It looks like she couldn't get much rest 
due to a lack of sleep...
